title: Making my first management sim with AI, the small UI problems keep getting me
author: LaonBuilds
selftext:
Hey all, i'm making cosmetics tycoon: founder's dilemma, a pixel art biz sim where you run a beauty brand (product dev, cash flow, marketing, investor stuff). using AI for basically all of it, code included, disclosed on the itch page. 

Been fixing small ui stuff lately, title font was too wide and broke some menus, buttons had ugly borders, a warning banner used to hide behind the confirm button so people just missed it. none of it looked bad staring at one screen at a time, only showed up once i actually tried using the menus like a player would. anyone else building with AI, how do you catch this kind of stuff, some kind of checklist or just playtesting? 

free browser demo here if you want to poke at it: 

[https://otherchois.itch.io/cosmetics-tycoon-founders-dilemma](https://otherchois.itch.io/cosmetics-tycoon-founders-dilemma). 

happy to hear what's still broken
